author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a duplicate's commit, its plan's committed hop and its wait's end, is emitted once
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(query)!: an ignore-case match compares both texts after Unicode simple case folding, on every backend
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel): each command a batch settles is observed as a command alone is, its execution and append ended, in its own caller's trace
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(gradle-plugin): generateWowContract reruns when its pairing or a context's classes move, the TestKit builds do not watch the file system, and the minimum Kotlin is a real version
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(http,client)!: a command's answer is bounded after its head, and a command's event stream ends with end, without which its outcome is unknown
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kafka): a key's next message of a send goes to the broker only once its previous one is acknowledged, so a message Kafka refuses is never overtaken by its key's later ones
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(compiler): handlers are told apart by subscription name, a typealias receipt command is read through, and an @OnSchedule job in a class of no kind is refused
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: test(ga-e2e): the GA run creates its state topics with its log's 8 partitions, which its publishing nodes need since #6862
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a membership left by its last group removes its record: the loops its own stop cancels end no membership
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(host)!: CoSec's authorizers come after CoSec's pipeline, whose checker their condition needs, so wow.cosec.authorizer.enabled registers them
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(openapi): the document lists what every route reads and answers, held by a test against the routes
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(client): a command a node went silent on is never sent to it again, and at most once more, to another live node
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(compiler): six shapes that generated code which did not compile either compile or are refused, naming the declaration
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime)!: a state record goes to its aggregate's partition in the log, named in a wow-partitions header, so no key moves when its topic gains partitions
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(client): a gateway's bare 502 or 504 is no decided answer: the caller may send the command again with its request id
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a handler that names aggregates of its own context in @OnEvent(aggregates) reads those alone, as the Manifest says
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(http,runtime)!: a command's event stream answers 200 once the command is accepted, streams each hop as it is reached, and keeps the connection alive
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(host): the DataSource the host makes logs where it connects, never a credential its JDBC URL carries
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(manifest,runtime): a subscription of several events of one peer aggregate reads that aggregate, and no node takes a handler of another context's events for one of its own
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(client): a command whose outcome is unknown stays unknown when its retry finds no node to connect to
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: test: the runtime and observability test nodes walk every 100 ms, so a wait for a type's walk ends within a few runs, not at its 10 s bound
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: test(runtime): a chain into a context the node does not know times out at the saga's hop on a held deadline, not one raced against a second
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a tail whose probe read found nothing reads its partition once more at the next round, for another node's stream that lands after its block was named
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(http)!: a service route refuses a body that is not JSON and an Accept it cannot answer, and reads its body as a command's is read
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo): a group never throws once a member may have committed, and this node's closed client is the store unavailable
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel)!: several commands of one type to one target from one handling each take a business key, or the saga parks naming what to add, and a handler of each event's calls are told apart by their event
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): an id of a snapshot rebuild request whose history does not replay is parked, and the request's other ids rebuilt
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(http): a path segment holding a matrix parameter that names none is refused, not routed without it
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo): an append's round trips, all of them, are bound by append-timeout from the call's start
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(api): a Wow-Wait plan is read in time linear in its length, and refused past 4,096 characters or 32 hops before a hop is read
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel): a saga's own mistakes are unrecoverable wherever its derivation finds them, as a misused Wow API is
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a snapshot backfill is not marked caught up while it has aggregates parked, so their retry still writes them
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a node whose membership heartbeats or reads of the members ended steps out of every group it serves there
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(elasticsearch)!: every index is an alias of one concrete index, written with require_alias, so no write creates an index
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime,client): a problem names the failure it ran into by its class, never by the values its message carries, so a parked reason carries none
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a technical failure its source retries is not an inherited command's outcome, and a command the intake parks ends its wait
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(spi): a command sent while deciding derives its request id from the deciding request's type and tenant, not its aggregate id
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo)!: a log or timer collection is recorded in its registry under every ddl, and a block naming one without its record is not sealed
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(test-dsl): the replay check reads the clock again once its wait is over, so a spinning thread descheduled past the deadline passes a correct spec
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a node whose lease renewals ended steps out of the group instead of acquiring its partitions again
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a wait the owner already signalled answers what it was told when the broker's acknowledgement is lost or late
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo): a sequence is settled only on what a majority holds, and a tail stuck at one no block holds says how to repair it
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel): a failure of the kernel's own ports or checks under a decide function fails the command, never answered as the caller's refusal
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: docs(designs): 10.0.0-beta.21 is out, the route to RC1, and the first round of the deep review (D477–D479)
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a creation that names no aggregate takes its id last, so a request admission refuses reads and claims nothing
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(query)!: the core orders text by code point, as every store does
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo)!: a store's schema check compares each index's definition, not only its name
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel): a cancellation of a decide function's own, a call it bounded timing out, fails the command instead of reading as its caller's
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a request retried through a command topic answers as a duplicate at COMMITTED, as it does run directly
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo): the last of 4,096 partitions bounds its positions without overflowing
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(postgres): of two first starts with different partition counts only the stored one opens the log
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: docs(guide): an act a decision undoes is keyed with callId(), and an act that stands on the command
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(runtime): a topic's added partition is read from its beginning by every subscription, and JOIN decides who joined per partition
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel)!: a call a decision undoes takes callId(), and a call that stands must be the same call when decided again
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(postgres)!: a log or timer table without its registry row is recorded under every ddl, and a stalled tail warns
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(mongo): the timer store's due read takes its unions in aggregations of at most 500
author: Ahoo-Wang

t: fix(kernel): the log and the state trace hold a decision's events as it returned them, whatever its evolve functions do to them
author: Ahoo-Wang
